items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber removed from the damaged garden building
items.rationale: Disposal of damaged building timber is covered and necessary for the storm-damaged garden shed.

items.description: Disposal of the broken glass pane from the damaged shed
items.rationale: Disposal of broken glazing from the insured garden building is covered and related to the damage.

items.description: Disposal of green waste from the storm-felled tree (branches and foliage)
items.rationale: Clearance of storm-felled tree branches is covered under clearance costs but vegetation removal is limited.

items.description: Disposal of the tree root ball (single mass under one cubic metre)
items.rationale: Removal of root mass under 1 cubic meter is covered as material arising from the insured event.

items.description: Disposal of sieved topsoil from the churned-up ground
items.rationale: Ground material disposal alone is not covered unless part of ground works for reinstatement, which is not the case here.

items.description: Disposal of paving grit displaced around the shed
items.rationale: Displaced paving grit is ground material and its disposal is not covered without ground works.

items.description: Disposal of excavated soil from the churned-up ground
items.rationale: Excavated soil is ground material and disposal is not covered without necessary ground works.
